Prompting alone is not enough
      Prompting alone is not enough. AI requires review,
      editing, and contextualization.
      AI does not replace the teacher. The model does
      not know, for example, the OPS, the group, or the
      situation.
      The teacher guides the use. AI generates
      suggestions, the teacher evaluates and decides on
      their use.
      Operating model: AI draft → teacher checklist
      (facts/OPS/tone) → local adaptation → use or
      replace.
